items.title: Library Helpers Needed
items.text: Hi class, Next week we need helpers for the school book sale. The sale will be in the library from Monday to Wednesday. Helpers can arrive at 12:30 and finish at 1:00 during lunch. Please bring a water bottle because the room gets warm. If you want to help, tell Ms. Park by Friday. She will make a list and send it to your parents. Thank you! Mr. Lee

qs.q: What should helpers bring?
qs.why: 본문에 'Please bring a water bottle'이라고 나와 있어요.

qs.q: Why is this email written?
o: To ask students to help with a sale
To say a library is closing for a week
To explain a new school rule
To thank students for a gift
qs.why: 책 판매 행사를 도울 학생을 구하는 이메일이에요.

qs.q: In the email, the word "warm" is closest to
qs.why: warm은 '따뜻한, 약간 더운'이라는 뜻으로 a little hot과 가장 가까워요.

qs.q: Who is "She" in "She will make a list"?
qs.why: 학생들은 Ms. Park에게 알리고, 'She'는 목록을 만드는 Ms. Park을 가리켜요.

qs.q: What can we guess about the helpers?
o: They give up their lunch time
They sell books to their families at home
They must be in sixth grade
qs.why: 도우미는 점심시간(12:30~1:00)에 일하므로 점심시간 일부를 쓰게 돼요.

items.title: Swim Class Poster
items.text: Summer Swim Class! The town pool is starting a class for beginners aged seven to ten. Lessons are on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 4 p.m. for four weeks. Each lesson lasts forty minutes. Children should wear a swimming cap and bring a towel. The pool provides kickboards. Parents may watch from the benches, but they cannot enter the water. Sign up at the front desk before June 1.

qs.q: Who is the class for?
o: Adults who already swim very well
qs.why: 'for beginners aged seven to ten'이라고 나와 있어요.

qs.q: How long is each lesson?
qs.why: 'Each lesson lasts forty minutes.'라고 해요. four weeks는 수업 전체 기간이에요.

qs.q: What does "provides" mean here?
qs.why: provides는 '제공하다'라는 뜻이고 gives와 가장 가까워요.

qs.q: What can we infer about parents?
o: They must swim in the water with their children
They can sit and watch the lesson
qs.why: 부모는 벤치에서 지켜볼 수 있지만 물에는 들어갈 수 없어요.

qs.q: What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To sell swimming caps and towels
To tell people about a class
qs.why: 수영 강습의 대상, 시간, 신청 방법을 알리는 포스터예요.

items.title: Grow a Bean
items.text: You can grow a bean plant at home. First, put a wet paper towel inside a clear cup. Next, place two beans between the towel and the cup. Put the cup near a window and keep the towel wet. After about five days, a small root will come out. Later, a green stem will grow up. When the plant is tall, move it into a pot with soil. Then it will keep growing.

qs.q: Where should the beans be put at first?
o: Between a towel and a cup
In a bowl of water near the sink
qs.why: 'place two beans between the towel and the cup'이라고 해요.

qs.q: What comes out of the bean first?
qs.why: 약 5일 후 작은 뿌리가 먼저 나오고, 나중에 줄기가 자라요.

qs.q: In the text, "keep" in "keep the towel wet" means
qs.why: keep the towel wet은 수건이 계속 젖은 상태로 있게 한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What does "it" refer to in "Then it will keep growing"?
qs.why: 흙이 든 화분으로 옮긴 뒤 계속 자라는 것은 식물이에요.

qs.q: What is this text mainly about?
o: How to start growing a plant
Why beans are good for your body
qs.why: 콩 식물을 키우는 방법을 순서대로 설명하는 글이에요.

items.title: Why Leaves Change
items.text: In spring and summer, leaves are green because they hold a green material called chlorophyll. Trees use it to make food from sunlight. In autumn, days become shorter and there is less light. The trees stop making chlorophyll, so the green color fades. Then yellow and orange colors, which were hidden all along, can finally be seen. Some leaves also turn red. At last, the leaves fall to the ground.

qs.q: What is chlorophyll used for?
o: Keeping leaves cold in the winter
qs.why: 'Trees use it to make food from sunlight'라고 해요.

qs.q: Why does the green color fade in autumn?
qs.why: 가을에는 빛이 줄어 나무가 엽록소를 만들지 않아서 초록색이 사라져요.

qs.q: The word "hidden" is closest in meaning to
qs.why: hidden은 '숨겨진', 즉 눈에 잘 보이지 않는다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What can we infer about yellow colors?
o: They are in the leaves before autumn
They come from the soil in spring
qs.why: 노란색은 'hidden all along'이었다고 했으므로 이미 잎 속에 있었어요.

qs.q: What is the main idea?
o: Trees need much more water in autumn
Autumn leaves change color for a reason
qs.why: 가을에 잎 색이 변하는 이유를 설명하는 글이에요.

items.title: The Missed Train
items.text: Yuna ran into the station, but the train to Busan was already moving. She stood still and felt worried. A station worker saw her and asked, "Are you OK?" Yuna showed her ticket. The worker smiled and said, "The next train leaves in twenty minutes. You can use the same ticket." Yuna sat on a bench and called her aunt. "I will be late, but I am safe," she said.

qs.q: Why was Yuna worried?
o: She was at the wrong station
qs.why: 기차가 이미 움직이고 있어서 놓쳤기 때문에 걱정했어요.

qs.q: What did the worker say about the ticket?
o: It costs more money to use again
qs.why: 'You can use the same ticket.'이라고 했어요.

qs.q: How did Yuna probably feel at the end?
qs.why: 해결책을 듣고 이모에게 전화하며 안전하다고 말했으므로 처음보다 안심했어요.

qs.q: In the text, "still" in "stood still" means
qs.why: stood still은 '가만히 서 있었다'라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Who is "She" in "She said" at the end?
qs.why: 이모에게 전화해서 늦는다고 말한 사람은 Yuna예요.

items.title: Making Songpyeon
items.text: At Chuseok, many Korean families make songpyeon, a half-moon rice cake. First, they mix rice flour with warm water to make soft dough. Then they take a small piece and press it flat. They put sweet sesame or chestnut inside and fold the dough. Finally, they steam the cakes on pine needles. The needles give the songpyeon a nice smell. Families often make them together and talk while they work.

qs.q: What shape is songpyeon?
qs.why: songpyeon은 'half-moon rice cake'라고 소개돼요.

qs.q: What is done right after the dough is pressed flat?
o: The flour is mixed with water
qs.why: 반죽을 납작하게 누른 다음 속을 넣고 접어요.

qs.q: Why are pine needles used?
qs.why: 솔잎이 송편에 좋은 향을 준다고 했어요.

qs.q: What can we infer about making songpyeon?
o: It is often a family activity
It is usually done by one person alone
qs.why: 가족이 함께 만들며 이야기한다고 했어요.

qs.q: The word "fold" is closest in meaning to
qs.why: fold는 반죽을 접어서 닫는다는 뜻이고 bend and close와 가장 가까워요.

items.title: The Clever Octopus
items.text: An octopus has eight arms and no bones, so it can squeeze through very small spaces. Even a large octopus can fit through a hole the size of a coin. It also changes color to hide on rocks or sand. Scientists say octopuses are clever. In one test, an octopus opened a jar to get the crab inside. When danger comes, it can shoot dark ink into the water and swim away quickly.

qs.q: Why can an octopus go through small spaces?
qs.why: 뼈가 없어서 아주 작은 공간도 통과할 수 있어요.

qs.q: What did the octopus do in the test?
qs.why: 실험에서 문어는 안의 게를 얻기 위해 병을 열었어요.

qs.q: What does "clever" mean here?
qs.why: clever는 '영리한'이라는 뜻이고 smart와 비슷해요.

qs.q: What does "it" refer to in "it can shoot dark ink"?
qs.why: 위험할 때 먹물을 쏘는 것은 문어예요.

qs.q: What is the best title for this text?
o: Animals That Fly Over the Sea
Amazing Things an Octopus Can Do
qs.why: 문어의 놀라운 능력들을 소개하는 글이에요.

items.title: A Check-up
items.text: Daniel did not like going to the clinic. He was nervous when the nurse called his name. In the room, she measured his height and listened to his heart. "You are two centimeters taller than last year," she said. Daniel smiled a little. Then the doctor looked at his teeth and gave him a sticker. On the way home, Daniel told his father, "That was not so bad after all."

qs.q: What did the nurse measure?
qs.why: 간호사는 키를 재고 심장 소리를 들었어요.

qs.q: How did Daniel feel when he arrived?
qs.why: 간호사가 이름을 불렀을 때 긴장했다고 해요.

qs.q: What does Daniel's last sentence suggest?
o: He will never go to the clinic again
He is angry at his father
His feelings about the visit changed
qs.why: 'not so bad after all'은 처음 생각과 달리 괜찮았다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Who gave Daniel a sticker?
qs.why: 치아를 본 의사가 스티커를 주었어요.

qs.q: In the text, "measured" means
qs.why: measured는 크기를 재었다는 뜻이에요.

items.title: A Paper Bookmark
items.text: Here is an easy way to make a bookmark. You need a piece of paper, scissors, glue, and markers. First, cut the paper into a long strip about five centimeters wide. Next, draw a picture or write a short word on one end. Then fold a small corner at the top to make a triangle and glue it down. Slide the triangle over a page corner, and your bookmark will hold the place.

qs.q: What is the first step?
o: Cut the paper into a strip
Draw a picture on one end
qs.why: 첫 단계는 종이를 긴 띠 모양으로 자르는 것이에요.

qs.q: What is the triangle used for?
qs.why: 삼각형을 페이지 모서리에 끼워 쪽수를 표시해요.

qs.q: What does "hold the place" mean?
o: Keep your seat on a bus
Carry a book home from school
qs.why: 책갈피는 읽던 곳을 기억하게 해 줘요.

qs.q: What does "it" most likely mean in "glue it down"?
qs.why: 풀로 붙이는 것은 접어서 만든 삼각형이에요.

qs.q: What kind of text is this?
qs.why: 책갈피를 만드는 방법을 단계별로 안내하는 글이에요.

items.title: Online Class Notice
items.text: Dear students, Tomorrow our art class will be online because the school room is being painted. Please open the video link at 10:00. Sit in a quiet place and keep your camera on if possible. You will need a pencil, a sheet of white paper, and your colored pencils. We will draw a spring tree together. If the link does not work, call the school office. See you tomorrow! Ms. Choi

qs.q: Why is the class online?
qs.why: 학교 교실을 페인트칠하고 있기 때문이에요.

qs.q: What will students draw?
qs.why: 'We will draw a spring tree together.'라고 해요.

qs.q: What should students do if the link fails?
qs.why: 링크가 작동하지 않으면 학교 사무실에 전화하라고 해요.

qs.q: The word "quiet" is closest to
qs.why: quiet은 조용한 장소를 뜻해요.

qs.q: Why did Ms. Choi write this notice?
o: To say sorry for a mistake
To prepare students for an online class
To sell art supplies to the class
qs.why: 온라인 수업 시간, 준비물, 문제 해결 방법을 안내해요.

items.title: The Red Kite
items.text: On a windy afternoon, Lena took her red kite to the park. The wind was strong, and the kite flew high above the trees. Suddenly, the string broke! The kite sailed over the pond and landed in a tall tree. Lena could not reach it. A man who was walking his dog saw her sad face. He found a long stick and carefully lifted the kite down. "Thank you so much!" said Lena.

qs.q: Why did the kite fly high?
qs.why: 바람이 강해서 연이 높이 날았어요.

qs.q: What happened after the string broke?
o: The kite fell in the pond
The kite landed in a tree
qs.why: 연은 연못 위를 지나 높은 나무에 걸렸어요.

qs.q: How did Lena probably feel when the kite was in the tree?
qs.why: 산책하던 사람이 그녀의 슬픈 얼굴을 보았다고 했어요.

qs.q: In the text, "reach" means
qs.why: reach는 손이 닿다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Who does "He" refer to?
o: A worker who takes care of the park
qs.why: 막대기로 연을 내려 준 사람은 개와 산책하던 남자예요.

items.title: Bus Trip Rules
items.text: Our class trip to the science museum is next Thursday. The bus will leave school at 8:30 a.m., so please arrive ten minutes early. Wear comfortable shoes because we will walk a lot. Lunch is not provided, so bring your own. You may bring a small camera, but do not use it during the planetarium show. We will return to school at 3:00 p.m. Please follow your teacher's directions at all times.

qs.q: When will the bus leave?
qs.why: 버스는 오전 8시 30분에 출발해요. 10분 일찍 오라는 것은 도착 시간이에요.

qs.q: What must students do about lunch?
qs.why: 'Lunch is not provided, so bring your own.'이라고 해요.

qs.q: Why should students wear comfortable shoes?
qs.why: 많이 걸을 예정이기 때문이에요.

qs.q: What does "provided" mean here?
o: Taken by the bus to the museum
qs.why: provided는 학교가 제공한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is not allowed during the show?
qs.why: 플라네타륨 쇼 동안은 카메라를 사용하면 안 돼요.
